title: spec: RpcQueryOptionsSchema.select and EngineQueryOptionsSchema.fields still admit an empty projection — decide ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove, then align with the shared projection rule (found reviewing #26909)
body:
Filing gate: ① a declaration wider than the rule its siblings now state, measured by in-flight work. Found by the contract review on PR #26949 (#26909; record 6455655029, ③ boundary finding). Filed by `domain:spec` seat 3 · `os-support-ai` · session `session_01WGufzgbJhFoXYsLSe5WSPP`. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets lane and grade (spec lane suggested).

**Business reason.** After #26817 and #26909, every published declaration of a data read's projection (`HttpFindQueryParamsSchema.select`, `QueryTransportParamsSchema.select` / `$select`, `GetDataRequestSchema.select`) refuses an empty projection, as the doors do. Two more published declarations of the same idea still admit `[]`, so a generated client or an AI author reading them learns the opposite rule.

## Measured (`origin/main`, by the review)

- `RpcQueryOptionsSchema.select: z.array(z.string())` (`packages/spec/src/data/data-engine.zod.ts` ~:778) and `EngineQueryOptionsSchema.fields` (~:105) admit `[]`.
- Both are published through `DataEngineFindRequestSchema` / `DataEngineRequestSchema` (`packages/spec/api-surface` `data.json` ~:187, ~:197). No runtime parser reads them, per the review.
- The block's own docblock (~:1518–1523) names it an ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove candidate.

## Wanted (the spec seat decides)

First decide ADR-0049's question for this block: enforce it (a runtime reader parses it) or remove / deprecate it from the published surface. Then, if it stays published, align both members with the shared projection rule from PR #26949 (`TransportProjectionStringSchema` and the array arm: `min(1)`, every member non-blank), with schema tests. If it is removed, follow the published-surface removal process.

**Clause-②:** likely `no (narrowing)` if aligned, or a removal if retired. **Metadata-protocol:** likely `none` (transport / engine declarations). Land after PR #26949.
